blocks.text: Buying a Home in Pitt Meadows, BC: 5 Sub-Areas, Schools & Transit

parts.t: The City of Pitt Meadows offers a compact, master-planned urban core surrounded by 60 kilometres of scenic river dikes and protected farmland. Buyers searching active MLS® listings in Pitt Meadows compare five distinct sub-areas: Central Meadows around the Harris Road civic core and Pitt Meadows West Coast Express Station, Mid Meadows around Highland Park Elementary and Pitt Meadows Athletic Park, South Meadows and riverfront Osprey Village, North Meadows toward Pitt Lake and Swan-E-Set, and West Meadows at the Pitt River Bridge gateway.

According to the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® September 2026 MLS® HPI, the benchmark price in Pitt Meadows is $1,178,600 for a single-family detached house and $737,500 for a townhome. Families are served by School District 42, including Pitt Meadows Elementary (English and French Immersion K-7), Davie Jones Elementary, Highland Park Elementary, Edith McDermott Elementary, and Pitt Meadows Secondary (English and French Immersion 8-12).

blocks.text: Pitt Meadows 2040 OCP, 78% ALR Land Base & Floodplain Dike Areas

parts.t: Approximately 78% of Pitt Meadows' land base sits within the Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) and over 85% lies within the Fraser, Pitt, and Alouette river floodplains protected by four municipal dike drainage areas (Area 1 Alouette, Area 2 Fenton, Area 3 Kennedy urban core, and Area 4). Under the Official Community Plan 'I See Pitt Meadows 2040' and City of Pitt Meadows Zoning Bylaw No. 2505, 2011, urban residential growth is concentrated inside the Urban Containment Boundary in Central, Mid, and South Meadows.

blocks.text: Frequently Asked Questions About Pitt Meadows Homes for Sale

parts.t: What are the five neighbourhoods in Pitt Meadows, BC?
Pitt Meadows is organized into five MLS® sub-areas:
Where is the West Coast Express station in Pitt Meadows?

Pitt Meadows West Coast Express Station is located at 12185 Harris Road in Central Meadows, right at the Harris Road rail crossing, providing weekday commuter train service to Coquitlam, Port Moody, Burnaby, and Waterfront Station in downtown Vancouver.
What are the current benchmark home prices in Pitt Meadows?

In the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® September 2026 MLS® Home Price Index report, the Pitt Meadows benchmark price was $1,178,600 for a single-family detached house and $737,500 for a strata townhome, with active condos typically priced from the mid-$400,000s to the $800,000s.
Which SD42 schools serve Pitt Meadows families?

Pitt Meadows is served by four SD42 public elementary schools—Pitt Meadows Elementary (11941 Harris Rd, English and Early French Immersion K-7), Davie Jones Elementary (12030 Blakely Rd), Highland Park Elementary (18961 Advent Rd), and Edith McDermott Elementary (12175 Bonson Rd)—all feeding into Pitt Meadows Secondary (19438 116B Ave, English and French Immersion 8-12).
How do the Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) and floodplain rules work in Pitt Meadows?

Because 78% of Pitt Meadows lies in the ALR and over 85% sits behind 60 km of river dikes, rural properties in North Meadows, West Meadows, and South Meadows are subject to ALC house-size limits, City of Pitt Meadows Zoning Bylaw No. 2505, 2011 agricultural siting rules, and floodplain flood construction levels (FCLs).
Where is Osprey Village located in Pitt Meadows?
